description: This file implements a UWP launcher for the Starboard abstraction, managing app installation, execution, crash dump handling, and process control on Windows UWP platform.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class to run and manage a UWP application, including installation, execution, crash dump detection, and termination.

methods.name: GlobalVars
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of global variables.

methods.name: FirstRun
methods.description: Determines if this is the first run based on a global variable.

methods.name: WaitForFileToAppear
methods.description: Polls for a file to appear within a timeout period.

methods.name: FindAppxDirectoryOrRaise
methods.description: Finds the directory containing the AppxManifest.xml or raises an error.

methods.name: CommandArgsToDict
methods.description: Parses command-line argument string into a dictionary.

methods.name: GlobFiles
methods.description: Returns list of files matching a pattern in a directory.

methods.name: Launcher.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the launcher, sets up paths, and installs the app if first run.

methods.name: Launcher.InitInstallAppxPackage
methods.description: Removes existing package and installs a new Appx package.

methods.name: Launcher.Output
methods.description: Outputs a string to the launcher’s output file.

methods.name: Launcher.WaitForExecutionCompletion
methods.description: Waits for app execution to complete by monitoring log files.

methods.name: Launcher.ResolveAliasName
methods.description: Resolves the executable name to an alias, preferring '-starboard' variants.

methods.name: Launcher.Run
methods.description: Starts the app, waits for completion, and handles crashes.

methods.name: Launcher.DeleteFiles
methods.description: Deletes dump files matching a pattern.

methods.name: Launcher.DetectAndHandleCrashDump
methods.description: Detects crash dumps and prints mini dumps.

methods.name: Launcher.GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Placeholder for getting device output path.
